reference_sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS bliksem_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id),
s AS (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS stroomhuis_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id)
SELECT p.product_name, b.bliksem_min_eur, s.stroomhuis_min_eur, s.stroomhuis_min_eur - b.bliksem_min_eur AS gap_eur
FROM b
FULL OUTER JOIN s ON s.product_id = b.product_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = COALESCE(b.product_id, s.product_id)
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'Audio'

solver.query:
WITH mins AS (
  SELECT cp.product_id,
         MIN(CASE WHEN cp.competitor = 'Bliksem' THEN cp.price_eur END) AS bliksem_min_eur,
         MIN(CASE WHEN cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis' THEN cp.price_eur END) AS stroomhuis_min_eur
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  WHERE cp.competitor IN ('Bliksem', 'Stroomhuis')
    AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY cp.product_id
)
SELECT p.product_name, m.bliksem_min_eur, m.stroomhuis_min_eur,
       m.stroomhuis_min_eur - m.bliksem_min_eur AS gap_eur
FROM mins m
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = m.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'Audio'
